title: RCR-Router: Efficient Role-Aware Context Routing for Multi-Agent LLM Systems with Structured Memory
abstract: arXiv:2508.04903v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly organized into multi-agent systems for complex reasoning and decision-making tasks. However, scaling such systems can substantially increase inference cost, especially when multiple agents repeatedly process overlapping or role-irrelevant context. Many existing multi-agent frameworks focus on orchestration and role specialization, but still rely on full-context sharing or static context routing, leading to redundant token consumption, increased runtime, and inefficient memory utilization. We present \emph{Role-Conditioned Context Routing (RCR)}, an execution-time layer that allocates role-relevant shared-memory items to agents under token budgets. Given a structured shared memory and a set of role-specialized agents, RCR selectively routes task-relevant memory items to each agent according to its role, optional task-stage metadata, and token budget. translated_title: RCR-Router：面向具有结构化记忆的多智能体LLM系统的高效角色感知上下文路由
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体正日益被组织成多智能体系统，用于执行复杂的推理和决策任务。然而，此类系统的规模扩展会显著增加推理成本，尤其是当多个智能体反复处理重叠或与其角色无关的上下文时。许多现有多智能体框架专注于编排和角色专业化，但仍依赖于全上下文共享或静态上下文路由，导致冗余的token消耗、运行时间增加以及记忆利用效率低下。我们提出了角色条件上下文路由（RCR），这是一个执行时层，可在token预算下为智能体分配与其角色相关的共享记忆条目。给定一个结构化的共享记忆和一组角色专业化智能体，RCR根据每个智能体的角色、可选的任务阶段元数据以及token预算，选择性地将与任务相关的记忆条目路由给各个智能体。
tldr: 提出角色条件上下文路由机制（RCR），在token预算约束下根据智能体角色选择性地将结构化共享记忆中的任务相关条目路由给各智能体，从而降低多智能体LLM系统的推理成本与冗余token消耗。
en_tdlr: Proposes Role-Conditioned Context Routing (RCR), an execution-time layer that selectively routes task-relevant structured memory items to role-specialized agents under token budgets, reducing inference costs and redundant token consumption in multi-agent LLM systems.
